page_title: LAZ 1-1 ROM | Lazio v AS Roma 13/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
88' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
88' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Matias Soule walks off the pitch to be replaced by Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).
88' The referee is firm and issues Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) a deserved yellow card.
87' Lazio keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
84' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Artem Dovbyk will be replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
82' The resulting corner from Pedro (Lazio) is cleared.
82' Matias Soule (AS Roma) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
81' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) comes onto the pitch for Mattia Zaccagni.
79' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Reda Belahyane (Lazio) replacing Fisayo Dele-Bashiru.
79' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mile Svilar intercepts the ball.
76' A cross from a corner kick by Lazio is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
75' A snap shot by Pedro (Lazio) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Mile Svilar produces a good save to thwart him.
73' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) replaces Taty Castellanos.
73' That will be all from Gustav Isaksen who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pedro (Lazio).
73' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.

69' 1 - 1 Goal! The ball sits up nicely for Matias Soule (AS Roma) and he hits a crackerjack of a strike past the goalkeeper. It ricochets off the top of the left post into the back of the net. This could be the goal of the month.
67' AS Roma will take a corner kick.
66' Matias Soule (AS Roma) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

65' Christos Mandas makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Zeki Celik (AS Roma) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the goal.
63' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
61' The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
61' Surely that's handball by one of the AS Roma players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
59' Here's the change. Lorenzo Pellegrini leaves the pitch and Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
58' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
55' This is a yellow card! Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
54' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
54' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AS Roma.
53' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
52' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
49' It looks like Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) saw red with that tackle. Simone Sozza won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. AS Roma win a free kick.
47' 1 - 0 Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 1:0.
46' Here is a change. Leandro Paredes is going off and Claudio Ranieri gives the last tactical orders to Bryan Cristante (AS Roma).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
42' Matias Soule (AS Roma) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
41' The referee points to the corner flag and Lazio will take a corner.
40' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
38' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
37' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the top left corner, but Mile Svilar is equal to it and makes an easy save.
36' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
34' Corner kicks – 3:2.
31' Angelino (AS Roma) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
31' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
30' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
29' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Matias Soule (AS Roma), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
26' Angelino (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement. Lazio are awarded a free kick.
24' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
22' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' A loose ball is pounced on by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the top right corner, but Mile Svilar is alert and makes a comfortable save.
22' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
20' Lazio keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
18' Matias Soule (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
17' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) will take a corner kick.
17' Matias Soule (AS Roma) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
15' Angelino (AS Roma) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.

12' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
11' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
10' The ball is cleared after Manu Kone (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

7' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt under the bar fails to beat Mile Svilar, who makes a sensational save.
5' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
2' The free kick from long range, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simone Sozza blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to AS Roma.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
Simone Sozza is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
